summary: Germany (DE) localization of Business Central 29. It covers ELSTER sales VAT advance notifications, VAT-VIES/EU Sales List reporting, Intrastat, GoBD/GDPdU digital audit exports, purchase delivery reminders, physical inventory orders, and XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Peppol e-invoicing.
overview:
The German layer adds statutory reporting on top of W1. VAT reporting is split into Sales VAT Advance Notifications (tables 11021 "Sales VAT Advance Notif." and 11023 "Elec. VAT Decl. Setup", codeunits 11021 "Elster - Initialize" and 11023 "Elster Management", report 11016 for the XML file) and VAT-VIES declarations. The VIES side extends the W1 VAT Report tables 740, 741 and 743 with fields and procedures, plus codeunit 11001 "VIES ELMA Xml" for the ELMA5 submission. Learn documents both flows under "How to Create VAT Reports [DE]", "Set up and export sales VAT advance notifications" and "EU Sales List in Germany".

Other local capabilities are the GoBD/GDPdU digital audit export (Data Export tables, pages 11002 to 11027, codeunit 11000, report 11015 "Export Business Data"), delivery reminders for vendors (tables and pages in the 5005270 range), Intrastat extensions with IDEV and eSTATISTIK.CORE submission channels, BilMoG currency valuation in exchange rate adjustment, and the Correction field handling in general journal posting.

E-invoicing is built on the E-Document framework with XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE formats (eServices and Peppol areas), including buyer reference handling. Company Information gains tax office, registration and Intrastat fields, and registration numbers are added to vendor and purchase documents.
key_points: ELSTER sales VAT advance notifications: own tables, setup page, role center actions and XML export report, documented on Learn
VAT-VIES and EU Sales List: W1 VAT Report tables extended with trade type, correction and supply fields; export via ELMA5 XML
GoBD/GDPdU digital audit: Data Export setup pages, record definitions and the Export Business Data report producing ZIP with XML index
Delivery reminders for vendors: header, line, issued and ledger entry tables, terms, levels, text, create/issue codeunits and test report
Intrastat DE: extensions for report header, line and setup, submission channel enum for IDEV and eSTATISTIK.CORE, places of dispatcher and receiver
E-invoicing: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE formats with import/export codeunits and buyer reference enum
BilMoG valuation method added to Exch. Rate Adjmt. Parameters and exchange rate adjustment subscribers
Physical inventory orders and recordings with posted counterparts, plus local reports such as Vendor Payments List and total-balance reports

areas.what: Adds German VAT reporting: the VAT Report header, line and setup tables get fields for trade type, corrections, supplies and VIES/ELMA transmission, with new export and validation procedures. Also adds the digital audit Data Export pages, VAT statement and VIES reports, G/L Total-Balance, and BilMoG fields on exchange rate adjustment parameters. Gen. Jnl.-Post Batch gets correction checks and a new event.
areas.why: Learn explains that VAT-VIES declarations feed the EU Sales List sent to BZSt, that corrections are resubmitted with the Corrected Notification field, and that BilMoG valuation applies at fiscal year-end. GoBD/GDPdU requires data exports for tax auditors.

areas.what: Introduces the delivery reminder process for vendors with header, line, issued and ledger tables, terms, levels, text, create and issue codeunits, pages and reports. Adds Registration No. to Vendor Templ., archive options to Purchases & Payables Setup, and local vendor reports such as Vendor Payments List.
areas.why: Learn documents delivery reminders as a way to remind vendors of late deliveries, and the Vendor Payments List as available in Austria, Germany and Switzerland.

areas.what: Adds German electronic invoicing through the E-Document framework: XRechnung and ZUGFeRD format codeunits, import and export, PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE handlers, buyer reference enum, and page, table and report extensions on sales and service documents.
areas.why: Learn states that Germany supports XRechnung, Peppol BIS 3 and ZUGFeRD, with buyer reference resolution and a Buyer Reference Mandatory setting.

areas.what: Adds Intrastat DE extensions (report header, line, setup, submission channel enum, filter codeunits, places of dispatcher and receiver), physical inventory order and recording tables with posted versions, and reports like Item ABC Analysis. Inventory Setup gets number series for physical inventory orders.
areas.why: Learn documents Intrastat export in XML with IDEV or eSTATISTIK.CORE channels, including checklist and test submission.

areas.what: Holds the ELSTER sales VAT advance notification objects: notification table, card and list, electronic VAT declaration setup and overview, Elster management codeunits and the XML file report. Also includes role center and VAT statement name extensions, ELSTER permission set extensions, and upgrade plumbing.
areas.why: Learn describes sales VAT advance notifications as the way German companies report VAT through the ELSTER portal via an XML file.

areas.what: Extends Company Information with tax office, authorized numbers, company number and Intrastat place fields. Adds DACH report selections, Format Address procedures for tax office, Document-Print procedures for VAT reports, and a Delivery Reminder source code.
areas.why: Learn says tax office and company data on Company Information are required for VAT report setup, and that registration numbers print on sales and purchase reports.

areas.what: Adds PEPPOL 3.0 DE validation, document info, party info, context and subscriber codeunits and a format enum extension for German Peppol output.

Adds fields to Fixed Asset (BWR depreciation book code, premium depreciation percent and amount), changes to depreciation book tables, a reclassification exclusion procedure in FA General Report, and local book value and list reports.
Extends the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets and adds delivery reminder permission set extensions.
Changes the Export Contact and Export Segment Contact XML ports.
Adds the Customer Total-Balance report and changes Sales Line Archive.
Adds an expense event subscriber for Germany.
Extends the Manufacturing Manager role center for DACH.
Adds document caption and document number label procedures to the Service - Credit Memo report.
Adds the GeneralMgt codeunit with local helper functions.

issues: Overview gives the GoBD pages as "pages 11002 to 11027". The Data Export pages in the input are 11002, 11003, 11004, 11007, 11008, 11009, 11014, 11026 and 11027. The same range also holds the ELSTER pages 11016, 11017 and 11019, so the range is a little misleading.

The delivery reminders key point mentions ledger entry tables. The input lists only the page Deliv. Reminder Ledger Entries (5005276). The header, line and issued header tables are listed, but no ledger entry table is.
Calling codeunit 11001 "VIES ELMA Xml" the ELMA5 submission piece is an inference from its name and from the Learn page on ELMA5. It is reasonable but not stated directly.
The ELSTER role center pageextensions are described as adding "role center actions". That is an inference from their names; the input does not say what they contain.
